property_summary: For every input, the reference contract C never allows a successful Collect call to transfer funds when block.timestamp == a holder's acc.unlockTime (it requires block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime); the mutant that relaxes the check to >= can allow a Collect to succeed exactly at unlockTime and thus change Acc for some key.
change_summary: Change the strict time check to allow collect at or after unlock (block.timestamp>=acc.unlockTime).
